C1327.title: Developer's Unauthorized Use of OpenClaw Agent Leads to API Key Leak
C1327.summary: A developer at a mid-sized tech company privately deployed the open-source autonomous AI agent tool OpenClaw on office endpoints to simplify operations, granting it excessive permissions. The tool's configuration file stored sensitive information such as database API keys and cloud service credentials in plaintext.
